findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler now has unimplemented abstract methods and will crash on instantiation
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler was changed from a DetectorHandler subclass with a stub `evaluate` to a bare `StatefulDetectorHandler` subclass with no method implementations. StatefulDetectorHandler declares four abstract members (`counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and the newly added `build_occurrence_and_event_data`), so calling `MetricAlertDetectorHandler(detector)` — which is exactly what `Detector.detector_handler` does for any detector of type `metric_alert_fire` — will raise `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class ... with abstract methods ...`. Previously this handler could be instantiated and evaluated (returning an empty list). Either implement the abstract methods with stubs/TODOs or keep the class abstract in a way that prevents it being registered as `MetricAlertFire.detector_handler`.

findings.title: StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate docstring still says it returns a list
findings.body: The docstring for `StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate` reads 'Evaluates a given data packet and returns a list of `DetectorEvaluationResult`', but the method now returns a `dict[DetectorGroupKey, DetectorEvaluationResult]`. The stale documentation contradicts the signature change made in this PR and will mislead implementers of subclasses.
